title: Patrata — find the government schemes you qualify for
tagline: Find the government schemes you qualify for.
lede: Answer a few questions. Open rules decide, right here in your browser, and show you why. No sign-up, no name, no ID number.
greeting: I can check which central government schemes you likely qualify for, explain why, point you to the questions that matter most, and build your document checklist. For state schemes I can ask Rajya Desk, after you agree.
assistantLine: Ask in your own language. The assistant runs the same open rules as the page, explains each result, and can ask the linked state desk after you agree.
